overview_description.description:
We are building Dubai’s first dedicated ultra-fast charging network for fleet operators, addressing a critical gap in the market. While public charging infrastructure is expanding, it is not designed for high-utilization fleet operations such as taxis, ride-hailing, and logistics. Our megawatt rated (5x 180kW charger) ultra-fast charging hubs will enable quick turnarounds, reduce downtime, and optimise fleet efficiency with AI-powered load management.
We are market-ready with a fully developed software platform, a production-ready team, and a scalable business model. What sets us apart is our multi-payment system, supporting both traditional and cryptocurrency transactions, and an AI-powered customer support assistant that streamlines fleet charging management.
The UAE’s EV fleet charging market is projected to generate USD 562M (AED 2.06B) annually by 2030, creating a high-growth investment opportunity. We are seeking USD 1M (AED 3.67M) in funding to deploy strategic ultra-fast charging hubs in high-demand locations, ensuring a first-mover advantage in this growing sector.
With government backing, a strong revenue model, and a 3-5 year breakeven timeline, this is a prime opportunity to invest in the future of fleet electrification in the UAE.
